probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Close Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview Show image 1 Show image 2 Padiglione Cervia Pavilion, Cervia, 2022 Notes Client Nature park Type Pavilion Year 2022 Location Cervia Area 90 m² Status Completed Biblioteca Olona Casa Lario Padiglione Cervia A shelter for walkers and birdwatchers in the salt pans of Cervia, at the end of a two hundred metre boardwalk. The pavilion is nothing more than a roof and a bench. Larch columns, larch roof, larch deck, all joined with timber pegs so that no steel touches the salt. It was built in nine days by four carpenters, and it can be taken apart and moved if the pans are ever flooded for good.
